name: io.github.WYRE-AI/foundu-mcp
title: FoundU
description: FoundU roster, hours, and labour-cost aggregates. No pay rates, bank details, TFNs, or employee PII.

environmentVariables.name: FOUNDU_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Australian FoundU tenant origin (https://<tenant>.foundu.com.au). Infinity Ben must grant partner API access.

environmentVariables.name: FOUNDU_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: FoundU partner API token. Steadfast owns credential rotation.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. Set to stdio for local CLI use; the image defaults to http for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
